claims.statement: Market regime strongly stratifies recycling outcomes in validation: NO_RECOVERY share is 22.7% (M_STRONG) / 32.8% (M_NEUTRAL) / 67.2% (M_WEAK); the confirmation pattern is flatter (23.1/15.2/23.5%) — regime-conditioned outcome structure is segment-dependent

Direct answer to the T6.4 core question, scoped to the tested representation: the PREREGISTERED breadth/new-high three-state market regime (M_STRONG/M_NEUTRAL/M_WEAK from mkt_breadth_5d and mkt_new_high_20d) did NOT separate true from false recovery within the hot-REDUCE subset — FR rate by regime: val 50.2/49.0/49.0% and conf 54.4/46.1/57.0%, pairwise CIs cross zero (SvW p=0.717 val, 0.551 conf). This rejects THIS regime representation as the separator; it does NOT establish that no external market variable separates — untested dimensions (liquidity, index trend, volatility, market microstructure, style) remain open, as does stock-internal path information
claims.evidence: A2 hot_subset blocks with CIs and SvW contrasts; scope limited to the preregistered regime definition per audit R1

claims.statement: Across ALL recovered cycles (unrestricted), the false-recovery rate is higher in M_STRONG than M_WEAK in validation (+7.4pp, Holm-significant) but reverses insignificantly in confirmation (-2.5pp, p=0.215); the contrast vanishes inside the hot subset. The result is CONSISTENT WITH a recovered-pool composition difference across regimes; T6.4 did not identify the mechanism producing that composition difference
claims.evidence: A2 all_recovered vs hot_subset blocks; Holm within family (only val all_recovered SvW survives)

claims.statement: E3 shows lower median abs_mdd and lower terminal-failure rate than E1/E2 in ALL SIX segment-x-regime strata (2 segments x M_STRONG/M_NEUTRAL/M_WEAK) — direction-consistent with no market-regime direction reversal. A3 reports level CIs per stratum; pairwise E3-minus-E1 difference inference was NOT performed, so this is a direction-preservation finding, not a proof of regime-uniform effect sizes
claims.evidence: A3_eclass_by_regime level CIs, all six strata (e.g. val abs_mdd E3 vs E1: 0.047/0.051/0.033 vs 0.066/0.061/0.050; conf p_terminal_failure E3 0.483/0.457/0.580 vs E1 0.614/0.537/0.682)

claims.statement: Descriptive conditional structure (PARTIALLY, no interaction contrast tested): the E2-minus-E1 terminal-failure excess is largest in M_WEAK (val +4.5pp; conf +3.7pp) and smallest in M_STRONG (conf +1.2pp); an (E2-E1)_WEAK minus (E2-E1)_STRONG interaction contrast with CI was NOT computed, so regime-amplification is a descriptive reading, not an established interaction
claims.evidence: A3 p_terminal_failure by E x regime

claims.statement: Sector-level interaction (contract regime_prereg sector_metrics) is UNAVAILABLE for analysis: the four preregistered sector metrics are not present in the frozen T6.0 fact layer. This is a data boundary recorded as-is (NOT evidence of absence of sector effects); the preregistration marks sector analyses EXPLORATORY ONLY in any case
claims.evidence: t6_0_daily_master schema contains no sector columns; EXPLORATORY_sector blocks report UNAVAILABLE
